formal_statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size ≤ 10 ∧ ∀ x : Fin 8 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = (fun x : Fin 8 → Bool => (x 0 && x 1) || (x 0 && x 2) || (x 1 && x 3) || (x 2 && x 4) || (x 3 && x 5) || (x 4 && x 5) || (x 6 && x 7)) x
plain_statement: The function on 8 inputs that is true exactly when both ends of some edge of the graph with edges 01 02 13 24 35 45 67 are true has a circuit of AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two with at most 10 gates (edges plus vertex cover number minus one). Every gate counted, inputs not.
title: Edge function of the 8-vertex graph with edges 01 02 13 24 35 45 67: a circuit of AND and OR gates of fan-in two with 10 gates
